note: Fresh independent-review inputs only. No intended decisions are embedded; the driver evaluates them in a separate reviewer session against the packaged skill.

cases.title: One settled worker sits beside protected terminals

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup inline after accepting one worker_done delivery.
input.request: Clean up resources from the accepted completion.
input.state: The matching Dispatch is settled. Its workspace also lists the current driver, a manual chat, a user_takeover terminal, and an idle terminal whose Task state is unknown.

cases.title: A settled worker is releasable while its worktree remains protected

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup inline after accepting the worker output.
input.request: Release completed subagent resources without losing candidate work.
input.state: The exact author Dispatch is settled and its required output is captured. Its worktree has useful unmerged changes and must remain available to the driver.

cases.title: A bounded backlog contains independent safe and uncertain resources

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup for Run run_old only.
input.request: Remove eligible completed subagent resources in that Run.
input.state: Two child workspaces have fully settled descendants and clean merged branches. A third has incomplete terminal inventory, and a fourth is dirty with an unpushed commit.

cases.title: A completed non-PR Task has the only copy of review evidence

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup inline for a completed supervised Task with no PR.
input.request: Retire the Task resources if safe.
input.state: Run, Task, Dispatch, head, workspace, and exact evidence files are known. There is no PR number. The first durable-record readback does not match the archive manifest identity.

cases.title: Runtime supports release, close, and worktree removal but no chat archive

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup for one accepted completed worker.
input.request: Clean it up and make the old chat disappear.
input.state: The version-matched guides advertise settled worker release, exact terminal close, and exact worktree removal. They advertise no chat archival operation. The worktree removal may delete its branch.

cases.title: A retry follows a failed native worktree cleanup hook

input.invocation: Resume axstack-cleanup for the same bounded backlog.
input.state: The prior receipt proves Dispatch release and terminal exit. Native worktree removal failed a hook and the workspace remains. Git and forge state may have changed since that receipt.

cases.title: An open PR has a settled review and a later review may be needed

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup after accepting the exact reviewer Dispatch.
input.request: Preserve the review evidence and retire eligible reviewer resources before PR merge.
input.state: The PR remains open. The detached reviewer child has a settled Dispatch, verified private archive and readback, and only classified run-owned scratch. The author candidate checkout holds useful unmerged work and must remain. A later revision may need another review in a new child checkout.

cases.title: Two settled review passes left separate scratch in one reviewer checkout

input.invocation: Run axstack-cleanup for the exact open PR and reviewer workspace.
input.request: Retire the reviewer workspace after preserving the accepted review evidence.
input.state: The open PR has two accepted, settled review Dispatches that used the same detached reviewer checkout because earlier cleanup was missed. Each recorded a different named run-owned scratch directory. Both directories contain untracked files, and one unrelated untracked file may also be present. The reviewer checkout has no tracked changes or unpushed commits; independently verified per-Dispatch private archives, fresh native liveness, complete Git status including ignored files, durable receipt readback, and exact directory inventories must determine whether removal is safe. The separate author candidate remains unmerged and protected.
